description: Manage the server-level library of reusable, cross-Novel content — stored entries, not generated synthesis or Novel-scoped lore. Entries cover NPCs, characters, scenes, encounters, lore, factions, rooms, things, templates, voice profiles, and adventures; they persist to `.holonovel-state/codex.json`, survive restarts, and mutations are audited. Requires the Editor or Game Master badge; reads are not badge-filtered. With no Novel active, the codex is the default store; `import`/`capture` need an active Novel. `set` needs `kind` + `name` (the id derives from them); merge=true shallow-merges content. `export` emits the library, or a `kind`/`id` selection, as one deterministic payload. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). Use when: storing reusable content, enumerating/reading/deleting it, or taking the library with you. Do NOT use when: storing Novel-scoped content — use manage_lore (action: set) or manage_note (action: set).

action.description: set (create/update), list, get, capture (Novel artifact per kind), import (into active Novel), export (the library as one interchange payload), or delete.

content.description: Entry content (for set); when omitted on an existing entry, the stored content is preserved.

entity_id.description: Entity whose voice to capture (for capture, voice_profile kind).

id.description: Entry identifier or array of identifiers (for import/get/delete).

merge.description: For set: when true and the entry exists, shallow-merge the provided content into the stored content instead of replacing it.

ruleset.description: Ruleset slug (for set/list); set defaults to the active Novel's scope, list returns matching plus untagged entries.

source_id.description: Novel artifact key/name/entity id to capture (for capture). Defaults per kind.

update_source.description: When true, update the source Codex entry in place (for capture).

name: manage_codex

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or ERROR; an error's Appendix O.2 category rides in `category` (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Codex Library Management
